question_text: How can you save fuel?

options.text: Change to a higher gear earlier
Change to a lower gear later
By driving frequently at high revolutions

correct_answers.text: Change to a higher gear earlier
Change to a lower gear later

comment: You as a car driver can save fuel when you are traveling with your vehicle at low speeds. You should shift as early as possible into a higher gear and switch back as late as possible to keep the engine speeds low.

question_text: How can noise be avoided?

options.text: If possible, avoid strong acceleration
By switching off the engine if you have to wait or stop for a longer period
By driving at high revolutions

correct_answers.text: If possible, avoid strong acceleration
By switching off the engine if you have to wait or stop for a longer period

comment: Noise is generally generated by the running engine of a car. Driving at high speeds and strong acceleration contributes to increased noise. Stop the engine if you wait or park your vehicle somewhere for a longer amount of time.

question_text: How is avoidable noise caused?

options.text: By driving with a defective exhaust
By "playing" with the accelerator when standing still
By sounding your horn when in danger

correct_answers.text: By driving with a defective exhaust
By "playing" with the accelerator when standing still

comment: Avoidable noise can be caused by driving with a defective exhaust system or by "playing" with the gas while standing. If a car driver honks because of a dangerous situation, this does not count as avoidable noise, but serves to avert danger.

question_text: Why should you avoid driving off at a rapid pace?

options.text: Because the noise you cause annoys others
Because of heavier tyre wear
Because this is a great strain on the rear brake

correct_answers.text: Because the noise you cause annoys others
Because of heavier tyre wear

comment: Making a racing start is an additional noise pollution for other road users. You as a car driver damage your vehicle as well as the tires due to high wear and abrasion with a racing start. The environment is additionally burdened. On the other hand, the rear-wheel brake is no longer and not any less loaded when starting.

question_text: How can you avoid pollution of the environment and benefit your engine after a cold start?

options.text: Set off at low revolutions per minute without running the engine until it warms up
Do not accelerate, let the engine warm up while the vehicle is stationary
Accelerate several times when stationary so that a favourable operation temperature is quickly reached

correct_answers.text: Set off at low revolutions per minute without running the engine until it warms up

comment: If possible, do not allow your vehicle to warm up while you are stationary as this will damage the engine and the environment. If warming up is done at low engine speeds, you will help to protect both. The engine is only fully resilient after reaching the operating temperature (green area).

question_text: Which vehicles are allowed to enter this environmental zone?

options.text: A car with a red emissions sticker
A motorcycle
A car which meets the requirements for a green sticker even if it does not have an emissions sticker

correct_answers.text: A car with a red emissions sticker
A motorcycle

comment: Motor vehicle drivers are only allowed to drive their vehicles into an environmental zone if the vehicle has a valid sticker visibly attached to it, which at least corresponds to the qualifying plate (red, yellow, green). Motorcycles and vehicles with special rights are excluded from this regulation.

question_text:
What is caused by driving with winter tyres during the summer months?
It increases

options.text: - the fuel consumption
- tyre wear
- driving stability

correct_answers.text: - the fuel consumption
- tyre wear

comment: Every car driver should know that winter tires are designed for use in cold and snowy streets. By using them in summer months, the driving stability decreases. Greater rubber abrasion and tire wear lead to increased fuel consumption.

question_text: What motor vehicles may enter an environment zone that has this sign?

options.text: Motor vehicles with a green particulate emissions sticker
Motorcycles
Motor vehicles that meet the requirements for a green particulate emissions sticker, even if no such sticker is attached

correct_answers.text: Motor vehicles with a green particulate emissions sticker
Motorcycles

comment: The additional sign shows which motor vehicles with which sticker may enter. Motorbikes may enter in any case.

question_text: You want to wash your car. Where should you do this in the interests of environmental protection?

options.text: At a carwash
In a carpark
On an open road

correct_answers.text: At a carwash

comment: You should always wash your vehicle in a car wash. There, the wastewater is disposed of by the operators in an environmentally friendly manner. On the other hand, if you wash your vehicle on the road or in a parking lot, the water gets into the ground untreated.

question_text:
What increases the fuel consumption of your vehicle considerably?
The use of

options.text: - heated seats
- the air-conditioning
- the navigation device

correct_answers.text: - heated seats
- the air-conditioning

comment: Turning on the seat heating or air conditioning of your vehicle consumes a lot of energy and increases the fuel consumption of your car significantly. Navigation devices require relatively little power compared to these devices.

question_text: What are the effects of driving at high speed in motor vehicles with combustion engines?

options.text: Fuel consumption increases
The emission of harmful substances increases
The noise level is reduced

correct_answers.text: Fuel consumption increases
The emission of harmful substances increases

comment: Be aware that fast, high-speed driving results in high fuel consumption and high exhaust emissions. This also leads to more noise and to a not lower noise level.

question_text:
Why is an environmentally considerate driving style also beneficial for road safety?
Because environmentally considerate driving means

options.text: - driving in a far-sighted manner
- avoiding high speeds
- that with alternative fuels it is only possible to drive slowly

correct_answers.text: - driving in a far-sighted manner
- avoiding high speeds

comment: Alternative fuels can also be used to drive fast. However, you will be driving in an environmentally friendly way if you avoid high speeds, if you drive with foresight and thus avoid, for example, braking hard and starting again.

question_text: What must you know about catalytic converters?

options.text: A catalytic converter can be damaged or destroyed when the car is towed to start
A catalytic converter can be damaged when the engine starts after many unsuccessful attempts
Unburned fuel in the catalytic converter cannot cause any damage when the engine starts

correct_answers.text: A catalytic converter can be damaged or destroyed when the car is towed to start
A catalytic converter can be damaged when the engine starts after many unsuccessful attempts

comment: Vehicles with a catalytic converter should not be towed away. As a result, unburned fuel can flow into the catalytic converter and lead to damage or destruction of the catalyst. If the engine of the vehicle does not start even after several start attempts, the same consequences can occur.

question_text: Tyre wear is a burden to the environment. What can extend tyre life?

options.text: Avoiding high speeds
Observing the tyre pressure indicated in the owner's manual
Using winter tyres (M+S) in the summer

correct_answers.text: Avoiding high speeds
Observing the tyre pressure indicated in the owner's manual

comment: The wear of tires is the lowest when the tires are used as intended. Winter tires that are used in summer wear faster due to their material properties (rubber compound). Even with too little air pressure tires wear faster. Starting with high-speed and squealing tires wears tires due to increased abrasion.

question_text: How can you save fuel when driving a motor vehicle with automatic transmission?

options.text: By not using the "kick down" facility, if possible
When driving in town traffic, always keep the selector lever in the lowest gear
By driving in gear "P", if possible

correct_answers.text: By not using the "kick down" facility, if possible

comment: Avoid the kick-down. The high-speed acceleration gear causes increased fuel consumption. For overtaking or merging on the freeway, however, it can be useful. With P, Parking, a vehicle with automatic transmission cannot be driven. Changing gears early to a higher gear also saves fuel.

question_text: How can you keep the burden on the environment low?

options.text: By forming car pools
By avoiding peak traffic periods
By avoiding roads with frequent traffic jams

correct_answers.text: By forming car pools
By avoiding peak traffic periods
By avoiding roads with frequent traffic jams

comment: In order to relieve the environment, you should form carpools with others as a car driver. The environment is particularly burdened by the number of moving vehicles. In addition, you should avoid a concentrated accumulation of several vehicles such as traffic jams.

question_text: What results in increased fuel consumption of your car?

options.text: A roof rack or ski rack
Transporting unnecessary objects
Excessive tyre pressure

correct_answers.text: A roof rack or ski rack
Transporting unnecessary objects

comment: Increased fuel consumption can be expected if, for example, you install roof or ski racks or if you load your vehicle with unnecessary objects. Increased tire pressure, on the other hand, does not matter for fuel consumption, even if it should be avoided altogether.

question_text: How can you save fuel?

options.text: By observing at least the tyre pressure indicated in the owner's manual
By removing roof racks or ski racks
Avoid driving in top gear

correct_answers.text: By observing at least the tyre pressure indicated in the owner's manual
By removing roof racks or ski racks

comment: Additional load and additional attachments such as roof racks or ski holders increase fuel consumption: when not in use, remove them. You save fuel when driving low-speed: shift up the gear early. Turning off the air conditioning system saves fuel, as does maintaining tire pressure according to the manufacturer's specifications. Because too little tire pressure increases the rolling resistance.

question_text: What should you avoid for reasons of environmental protection?

options.text: Letting the engine warm up when the vehicle is stationary
Unnecessary trips
Loud music with windows opened

correct_answers.text: Letting the engine warm up when the vehicle is stationary
Unnecessary trips
Loud music with windows opened

comment: After starting the engine, you as a car driver should start immediately in a low-speed driving style. Warming up the engine while stationary is not permitted. Driving at high speeds, extending gears and switching late, wastes fuel. Unnecessary driving causes avoidable exhaust emissions.

question_text: Which conduct shows awareness of the environment?

options.text: Changing to public transport at collective parking areas ("P + R")
The formation of car pools
Switching off the engine in a traffic jam

correct_answers.text: Changing to public transport at collective parking areas ("P + R")
The formation of car pools
Switching off the engine in a traffic jam

comment: Avoid driving around aimlessly. Private transport pollutes the environment. Make carpools as often as you can. If possible, use public transport. If you are stuck in a traffic jam, do not run the engine unnecessarily, turn it off.

question_text: How can you reduce noise?

options.text: By driving in 4th or 5th gear in built-up areas
By driving at high engine revolutions
By driving at high speed

correct_answers.text: By driving in 4th or 5th gear in built-up areas

comment: Driving in the high-speed range causes more noise than a low-speed driving style. In built-up areas you should drive in the highest possible gear, so that the engine causes the least possible noise. Avoid a high-speed start with squeaky tires.

question_text: What does "power sound" in the car result in?

options.text: Signals from other traffic - in particular sirens - are not heard
There is noise pollution for others even when the windows are closed
Driving errors due to the driver being diverted

correct_answers.text: Signals from other traffic - in particular sirens - are not heard
There is noise pollution for others even when the windows are closed
Driving errors due to the driver being diverted

comment: "Power sound" in the car causes over-stimulation. This over-stimulation may distract the car driver so that he/she may miss important other signals. Bear in mind that other road users are also bothered by the noise.

question_text: By which percentage does the fuel consumption (l/100 km) of a middle-class car driving at 160 km/h in general increase compared to driving at the recommended speed of 130 km/h?

options.text: By up to 35 %
By up to 5 %
By up to 10 %

correct_answers.text: By up to 35 %

comment: Compared to driving at the advisory speed limit of 130 km/h, the fuel consumption at a speed of 160 km/h usually increases very much. For example, the consumption of a mid-range car can rise by up to 35%.

question_text: When are you allowed to enter an environmental zone?

options.text: When your vehicle has a corresponding emissions sticker
When your vehicle enjoys special rights
When you have a low-emission vehicle

correct_answers.text: When your vehicle has a corresponding emissions sticker
When your vehicle enjoys special rights

comment: You may only drive into an environmental zone as a car driver if a valid badge is visibly attached to your vehicle that at least corresponds to the qualifying plate (red, yellow, green). Excluded from this rule are exclusively vehicles with special rights, for example historic motor vehicles.

question_text: Where do you have to place the emissions sticker for identifying lowemission vehicles?

options.text: Clearly visible on the inside of the windscreen
Clearly visible on the outside of the windscreen
Clearly visible on the inside of the rear window

correct_answers.text: Clearly visible on the inside of the windscreen

comment: As a car driver, you must ensure that the carbon emission sticker is affixed to the inside of the windshield of your vehicle so that it clearly identifies your low-emission vehicle.

question_text: If your car has a petrol engine but does not have an emissions sticker, are you allowed to enter an environmental zone which is sign-posted as follows?

options.text: No, because my car does not have an emissions sticker
Yes, because I am driving a car with catalytic converter with lambda control
Yes, because this prohibition only applies to diesel vehicles

correct_answers.text: No, because my car does not have an emissions sticker

comment: Without visibly attached carbon emission sticker, motor vehicle drivers are not allowed to drive into an environmental zone with a gasoline engine. The badge on the vehicle must be valid and correspond at least to the qualifying plate (red, yellow, green).

question_text: Where can you stow your baggage so that you do not increase your fuel consumption unnecessarily?

options.text: In the boot
Behind the front seats
On the roof-rack

correct_answers.text: In the boot
Behind the front seats

comment: If possible, you should only store the luggage in the trunk of your vehicle. The use of a roof rack to carry luggage results in greatly increased aerodynamic drag, often resulting in a significant increase in fuel consumption.

question_text: Tyre wear negatively impacts the environment. How can you reduce this impact?

options.text: By employing an anticipatory driving style
By regularly checking the tyre inflation pressure in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines
By using winter tyres in summer

correct_answers.text: By employing an anticipatory driving style
By regularly checking the tyre inflation pressure in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines

comment: To reduce tyre wear (i.e. the wear on the tyres), you can drive with foresight and significantly minimise the load by regularly checking the tyre pressure in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. Less wear = less load.

question_text: What can contribute to environmentally-friendly driving?

options.text: Attending a practical driving training session for a fuel-efficient driving style
Using vehicles with an electric drive
Forming car pools

correct_answers.text: Attending a practical driving training session for a fuel-efficient driving style
Using vehicles with an electric drive
Forming car pools

comment: If possible, carpool to reduce the number of vehicles on the road. Training can help you to adopt a fuel-efficient driving style. Electric vehicles do not emit any pollutants, so they are particularly environmentally friendly when driving.

question_text: How can you save fuel if you drive a car with an automatic gearbox?

options.text: Do not press down hard on the accelerator when moving off
Use the eco mode when driving
Switch off the engine when driving down a gradient

correct_answers.text: Do not press down hard on the accelerator when moving off
Use the eco mode when driving

comment: Unnecessary acceleration leads to high fuel consumption. Drive in eco mode if available. The car adapts its acceleration behaviour to reduce fuel consumption.

question_text:
What cars that are driven within designated environmental zones must display a particulate matter sticker?
Cars with

options.text: - petrol engines
- diesel engines
- electric motors

correct_answers.text: - petrol engines
- diesel engines
- electric motors

comment: In principle, all cars in a designated environmental zone are subject to the obligation to display a fine dust sticker. Work machines, ambulances, etc. are exempt.

question_text: What can result from listening to very loud music while driving a car?

options.text: The driver fails to detect signals from other traffic
It causes a nuisance to other road users
The driver’s responsiveness is enhanced

correct_answers.text: The driver fails to detect signals from other traffic
It causes a nuisance to other road users

comment:
Too loud music can cause warning signals and the like of other road users to be overheard. Too loud music can also annoy, disturb and thus endanger other road users.
The driver's ability to react deteriorates due to the loud music and the resulting reduced ability to concentrate.

question_text: Air resistance affects the fuel consumption of a vehicle. What affects air resistance the most?

options.text: The speed travelled
The number of passengers
The profile depth of the tyres

correct_answers.text: The speed travelled

comment:
The faster you drive, the greater the air resistance acting on your vehicle. Doubling your speed results in 4 times the air resistance. 
The tread depth of the tyres has a major effect on the rolling resistance of the tyres.
The number of passengers does not directly affect the air resistance.

question_text: You have to wait because a rail-crossing barrier is lowered. How can you now help protect the environment at this point?

options.text: By using the automatic start-stop system
By putting the vehicle in first gear
By activating the parking brake

correct_answers.text: By using the automatic start-stop system

comment: By using the automatic start-stop system, the vehicle can be switched off while waiting and immediately switched on again with little effort. This minimises the emission of pollutants. Applying the handbrake has no effect on the vehicle's pollutant emissions.

question_text: What increases the range of an electric vehicle?

options.text: Using a high energy recovery (recuperation) level
Reducing the heater temperature
Short, sharp acceleration

correct_answers.text: Using a high energy recovery (recuperation) level
Reducing the heater temperature

comment: If you only brake slightly, the electric motor brakes and the kinetic energy is recovered. If you brake harder, you will be mechanically braked and the kinetic energy will not be recovered. Due to a high recuperation level, an electric car behaves like a combustion engine, so you may have to brake less strongly, i.e. mechanically. The heating in the electric car is fed directly from the battery and thus consumes energy that could also be used for driving.

question_text:
What is the benefit of recuperation in an electric vehicle?
Recuperation

options.text: - increases range
- conserves the service brake system
- means that energy can be recovered from the braking operation

correct_answers.text: - increases range
- conserves the service brake system
- means that energy can be recovered from the braking operation

comment: Recuperation means "recovery". Just as electrical energy was converted into kinetic energy, braking converts the kinetic energy back into electrical energy, which is then fed back into the battery. This increases the range of the electric vehicle.

question_text:
Your car is equipped with an automatic start-stop system. What is the environmental protection benefit from using this vehicle system?
The automatic start-stop system reduces

options.text: - fuel consumption
- noise pollution
- tyre wear

correct_answers.text: - fuel consumption
- noise pollution

comment:
The automatic start-stop system automatically switches off the engine when you come to a standstill and restarts it as soon as you press one of the pedals. 
By switching off the engine, for example at traffic lights, the automatic start-stop system can reduce noise pollution and also save up to 15% fuel.

question_text: You are driving a car with a plug-in hybrid drive system. How can you optimise fuel consumption?

options.text: I regularly charge the battery using the mains supply
I use the electric drive through my driving style
I only use the recuperation to charge the battery

correct_answers.text: I regularly charge the battery using the mains supply
I use the electric drive through my driving style

comment:
By driving proactively - with gentle acceleration and timely braking - you can reduce your vehicle's fuel consumption. The electric motor is often used in this driving style. 
You can also reduce fuel consumption by regularly charging the battery of your plug-in hybrid on the power grid or minimize it by driving purely electrically.

question_text:
When planning your journeys, how can you make them environmentally-friendlier?
By

options.text: - combining several destinations into one single trip
- forming car pools with other vehicle users
- planning to use public transport instead of my own vehicle

correct_answers.text: - combining several destinations into one single trip
- forming car pools with other vehicle users
- planning to use public transport instead of my own vehicle

comment: For the sake of the environment, motorists should refrain from all trips that are not absolutely necessary. Therefore, plan your trips well and make carpools as often as possible to avoid unnecessary trips. Another positive contribution to active environmental protection is the use of public transport.

question_text:
How do you drive down a descending gradient safely?
I take my foot off the accelerator completely and

options.text: - select a gear in which I am not required to brake a great deal
- drive in neutral
- switch the ignition off

correct_answers.text: - select a gear in which I am not required to brake a great deal

comment: On a down grade, use the engine brake by shifting down to a lower gear. This relieves the service brakes. Under no circumstances change to idle! Because idling puts the engine brake out of action, thus the service brakes could overheat. In addition, the brake booster cannot work when the ignition is switched off. This considerably lengthens the braking distance.

question_text: What motor vehicles are permitted to enter an environment zone without a fine-particle badge?

options.text: All two and three-wheeled motor vehicles
All agricultural and forestry tractors
All motor vehicles with a catalytic converter

correct_answers.text: All two and three-wheeled motor vehicles
All agricultural and forestry tractors

comment: All two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles and agricultural and forestry tractors may enter an environmental zone without the carbon emission sticker. They are exempt from the restrictions of the environmental zone. The installation of a catalytic converter does not exempt you as a car driver from the obligation to obtain an environmental badge.

question_text:
What manufacturer specifications will allow you to know if your motor vehicle is environmentally-friendly?
From the details

options.text: - about the fuel consumption
- about the efficiency category
- about the emissions class

correct_answers.text: - about the fuel consumption
- about the efficiency category
- about the emissions class

comment: The emission class provides information about the emission of pollutants. The emission classes defined by the standard and/or the law subdivide products that emit exhaust emissions or interference signals. In the automotive sector, moreover, the following applies: The lower the fuel consumption, the higher the efficiency class and thus the environmental friendliness of the vehicle.

question_text:
Why are short journeys performed with a cold engine especially damaging to the environment?
Because driving with a cold engine means

options.text: - more fuel is consumed
- the level of material wear is higher
- the vehicle's battery will be over-charged

correct_answers.text: - more fuel is consumed
- the level of material wear is higher

comment: Short trips with a cold engine usually consume more fuel than driving with a motor in operating temperature. That's why they are particularly harmful to the environment. In addition, the friction is greater in short-distance driving with a cold engine. This leads to a higher material wear.

question_text: What causes avoidable noise?

options.text: By sounding the horn as a greeting
By firmly slamming doors shut
By driving with a roof-rack

correct_answers.text: By sounding the horn as a greeting
By firmly slamming doors shut

comment: All noise disturbances arising during normal operation of a vehicle are considered unavoidable. As a car driver, you should avoid any excess noise, for example, honking as a greeting or closing the doors very loudly. A roof rack will not cause you any avoidable noise.
